executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors during test compilation phase. The root cause is a mismatch between DTO constructors and service method signatures versus their usage in test classes. DTOs are being instantiated with arguments but are defined with no-argument constructors, and service methods are being called with incorrect parameter counts and types (long vs String/UUID).

errors.message: TaskCreateRequest constructor requires no arguments but called with 5 arguments
errors.root_cause: TaskCreateRequest DTO is defined with a no-argument constructor but test code attempts to instantiate it with (String, String, long, Priority, LocalDateTime). This pattern repeats across multiple test methods.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add an all-args constructor to TaskCreateRequest DTO or use builder pattern. Alternatively, update test code to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods.

errors.message: TaskResponse constructor requires no arguments but called with 9 arguments
errors.root_cause: TaskResponse DTO is defined with a no-argument constructor but test code attempts to instantiate it with 9 parameters including id, title, description, userId, priority, status, and timestamps.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add an all-args constructor to TaskResponse DTO or use builder pattern. Alternatively, update test code to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods.

errors.message: TaskService.createTask() requires 2 parameters (String, TaskCreateRequest) but called with 1
errors.root_cause: The TaskService interface defines createTask(String userId, TaskCreateRequest request) but test code calls it with only TaskCreateRequest. This indicates the service signature was changed to require userId but tests were not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all TaskService.createTask() calls in tests to include the userId parameter as the first argument. Extract userId from test context or use a test constant.

errors.message: TaskService.getUserTasks() requires 4 parameters but called with 3; long cannot be converted to String
errors.root_cause: The getUserTasks method signature expects (String userId, int page, int size, String sortBy) but tests call it with (long userId, int page, int size). The userId type changed from long to String.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getUserTasks() calls to pass userId as String instead of long, and add the missing sortBy parameter. Convert long userId to String using String.valueOf() or use UUID.toString() if applicable.

errors.message: TaskCountResponse constructor requires no arguments but called with 2 arguments
errors.root_cause: TaskCountResponse DTO is defined with a no-argument constructor but test code attempts to instantiate it with (long userId, int count).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add an all-args constructor to TaskCountResponse DTO or use builder pattern. Alternatively, update test code to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods.

errors.message: TaskService.getTaskById() requires 2 parameters (UUID, String) but called with 1 (long)
errors.root_cause: The getTaskById method signature changed to require (UUID taskId, String userId) but tests call it with only a long taskId. The task ID type changed from long to UUID and userId parameter was added.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getTaskById() calls to convert long taskId to UUID and add userId parameter. Use UUID.fromString() or generate test UUIDs, and extract userId from test context.

errors.message: TaskUpdateRequest constructor requires no arguments but called with 5 arguments
errors.root_cause: TaskUpdateRequest DTO is defined with a no-argument constructor but test code attempts to instantiate it with (String, String, Priority, TaskStatus, LocalDateTime).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add an all-args constructor to TaskUpdateRequest DTO or use builder pattern. Alternatively, update test code to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods.

errors.message: TaskService.updateTask() requires 3 parameters (UUID, String, TaskUpdateRequest) but called with 2; long cannot be converted to UUID
errors.root_cause: The updateTask method signature changed to require (UUID taskId, String userId, TaskUpdateRequest request) but tests call it with (long taskId, TaskUpdateRequest). The task ID type changed from long to UUID and userId parameter was added.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all updateTask() calls to convert long taskId to UUID and add userId parameter. Use UUID.fromString() or generate test UUIDs, and extract userId from test context.

errors.message: TaskService.deleteTask() requires 2 parameters (UUID, String) but called with 1 (long)
errors.root_cause: The deleteTask method signature changed to require (UUID taskId, String userId) but tests call it with only a long taskId. The task ID type changed from long to UUID and userId parameter was added.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all deleteTask() calls to convert long taskId to UUID and add userId parameter. Use UUID.fromString() or generate test UUIDs, and extract userId from test context.

errors.message: BulkTaskResponse constructor requires no arguments but called with 4 arguments
errors.root_cause: BulkTaskResponse DTO is defined with a no-argument constructor but test code attempts to instantiate it with (int successCount, int failureCount, List<TaskResponse>, List<Object>).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add an all-args constructor to BulkTaskResponse DTO or use builder pattern. Alternatively, update test code to use no-arg constructor followed by setter methods.

errors.root_cause: Test code attempts to call getCode() on ErrorResponse but this method is not defined in the ErrorResponse class. The method may have been removed or renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getCode() method to ErrorResponse class or update test assertions to use the correct method name (e.g., getErrorCode(), getStatus(), or similar).

errors.message: Type mismatch: long cannot be converted to String; Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore methods expect String userId and TaskPriority enum but tests pass long userId and Priority enum. This indicates a refactoring where userId type changed from long to String and Priority enum was renamed to TaskPriority.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest to convert long userId to String using String.valueOf() and use TaskPriority enum instead of Priority enum throughout the test class.
